capture.content: Disposable example projects only; no personal terminal sessions, host names, paths, pairing codes or credentials.
capture.method: Capture the running native app using simctl or adb, then frame each capture with .listing-kit/frame.py (brand background, caption and bezel). Never substitute mockups for the app screens; only the closing brand panel has no capture.
capture.playFraming: Use a device viewport with the intended aspect ratio; do not crop away the keyboard or app controls.
